annotations.title: Fannie Mae price adjustment (LLPA) for a scenario

description: Fannie Mae's published loan-level price adjustment (LLPA) for an anonymized conventional scenario (Classic FICO, LTV, loan amount, purpose, occupancy, property type), the dollar price it adds, and the structuring moves that lower it, with the matrix edition. An LLPA is a one-time price adjustment, never an interest rate and never a credit decision; the lender decides. Takes numbers only, never a borrower's name or details.

duty_to_serve.description: true if the loan may meet a Duty to Serve category (flagged as a possible waiver, never applied)

fico.description: representative Classic FICO score, e.g. 740. VantageScore 4.0 pricing is not loaded, so a VantageScore must not be given here: Fannie Mae's 09/30/2026 reissue of LL-2026-06 removed the separate VantageScore 4.0 grids, and DealMatcher has not encoded how a VantageScore is priced now.

high_balance.description: true if the loan is above the county baseline (high-balance)

ltv.description: loan-to-value, e.g. "90" or "80.5%". Read as Fannie Mae does (Selling Guide B2-1.2-01): truncated to two decimals, then rounded up to the whole percent.

mh_advantage.description: manufactured home only: true if it meets MH Advantage (no manufactured-home charge)

minimum_mi.description: true if the loan uses Fannie Mae's minimum mortgage insurance coverage option (adds the Minimum-MI charge)

property_type.description: DETACHED_CONDO and COOP do not pay the condo charge (matrix footnote 1)

subordinate_financing.description: true if there is a second lien (CLTV above LTV)

term_years.description: loan term in years; defaults to 30 and the answer says so. Fannie Mae's purchase and limited cash-out score grids apply only to terms over 15 years.
